title: The Secret Garden
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett

textRights.note: Original Project Gutenberg notice/license retained with the complete source. Underlying English work published 1911; author died 1924. No new translation or cover art included.

audioRights.attribution: Audiobook read by Karen Savage for LibriVox; source links retained per segment.

normalization: Original ebook retained byte-for-byte. Chapter copies preserve text with CRLF normalized to LF; no prose rewrite, audio synthesis or audio clipping.
educationalLimits: Fiction, not a scientific or medical source. Historical social views and dialect need explicit context; do not teach all dialogue as current standard usage.
Reading-ease scores for native-speaking children are not a CEFR rating for English beginners.
Book and audio may use different text editions; chapter identity alone does not prove word-for-word alignment. No listening questions or dictation are enabled until that comparison.
This collection is a candidate input pool, not an activated daily lesson or an independent IELTS test.
The last printed chapter has two original audio segments; both map to chapter 27 and do not create an additional unique text.
